name: Escorts Kubota Ltd
title: Escorts Kubota Ltd - 500495 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Escorts guides FY27 tractor industry flat to ±2-3% with H2 a substantial de-growth on high base and monsoon, while input costs (tyres, steel, base metals) rise 5-6% and only ~1.5% price taken in April.

capex.quote: Capex -- normal capex is in the range of INR350 crores, INR400 crores only.

triggers.label: Price hike only ~1.5% vs 5-6% cost
triggers.quote: we had taken about 1.5% sort of price increase in April across various brands

triggers.label: H2 FY27 substantial de-growth expected
triggers.quote: H2 would probably be a substantial de -growth basis these reasons. But H1 should be at par kind of a scenario.

triggers.label: FY27 industry flat to +/-2-3%
triggers.quote: The overall guidance for financial year '27 is kind of a flattish industry, 2%, 3% up, 2%, 3% down.

triggers.label: Greenfield capex >INR5,000 cr over 7-10 yrs
triggers.quote: overall plan, I think over the next 7 to 10 years will be to spend more than INR5,000 crores on this greenfield project

triggers.label: CE capacity utilisation ~47% last year
triggers.quote: last year our capacity utilization has been only 47%

guidance.quote: The overall guidance for financial year '27 is kind of a flattish industry, 2%, 3% up, 2%, 3% down.
Capex -- normal capex is in the range of INR350 crores, INR400 crores only.
I think this year will be only about roughly INR500 crores, somewhere around that.

guidance.metric: Component exports from India by FY30
guidance.quote: we expect anywhere between maybe INR500 crores to INR1,000 crores kind of number should happen by FY30
So our effort will be to maintain the margin on a full year basis.

red_flags.label: Input cost pass-through lagging
red_flags.quote: this is not really sufficient to take care of any of these price increases

evasions.quote: So we don't know where it will really end.
Too early to talk about FY '28.
